notes:
## What's Changed

### Features

- **Added macOS support** on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15 or later, running models with the [FreeToken-metal](https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken-metal) engine and updating itself in the app
- macOS: Added installing and updating the FreeToken-metal engine in the app, from the latest release or the untested nightly build
- macOS: Added a model catalog of MLX builds of Qwen3.6, Qwen3.5, Gemma 4, Flint and Ornith
- macOS: Added running a MoE model larger than memory by streaming its experts from the SSD
- macOS: Added packing a MoE model's experts for SSD streaming from its model details
- macOS: Added a per-model KV capacity setting
- macOS: Added following the system proxy in system proxy mode
- macOS: Added a monochrome menu bar icon
- Added a live monitor to the Console with speed, request and GPU history
- Added editing the API prices behind the cost-saved figure, including for models the price table lacks
- Added a summary of what an in-app update brought, shown on the next launch
- Added flint-40b-a2.5b to the model catalog
- Added a circular reveal when switching between dark and light themes

### Fixes

- Fixed text and icons rendering at different sizes and weights from machine to machine
- Fixed the window flickering while switching between dark and light themes
- Fixed the xhigh, adaptive, minimal and none thinking levels showing untranslated
